verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a published Management API OpenAPI spec, plain-text per-language reference corpora in llms.txt, and type generation. None of it documents an interactive API reference or runnable examples. An OpenAPI spec is a building block someone could use to construct an explorer, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
